subject: Convert planned demo into embedded architecture workshop
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena@quantapulse.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro demo for Quantapulse — scheduling

Hi Neha (and Marissa),

Thanks again for the quick intro last week — the execs liked the high-level run-through. We're hoping to move from the demo into something more engineering-focused to validate integration approaches. Can we keep the original demo slot on Mar 31 but make it a 90-minute embedded-architecture session instead? Key goals: map data flows, confirm latency targets, and discuss auth/KMS.

Attendees: me, our CTO Arun Patel, and two platform engineers. We can do afternoons PT except the 31st morning is tight for us. Any prework you want from us?

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morris
Head of Platform
Quantapulse Solutions
elena@quantapulse.com

--
Attachment: quantapulse_prework_questions.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@quantapulse.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo for Quantapulse — scheduling

Hi Elena — great to hear the execs found value. Quick update from our side: Vivek (solutions engineering) will lead the technical deep dive; Marissa will support the higher-level procurement/timeline questions.

Two constraints on our end that affect the Mar 31 slot: 1) Our lead infra engineer is traveling Mar 30–Apr 2 and we'd like them for the session, and 2) to make the session actionable we recommend 90 minutes with a short prework doc so we can focus on architecture rather than product tour.

Proposal: convert the Mar 31 demo into a 90-minute "Embedded Architecture Workshop" and move to Apr 6 or Apr 7 afternoon PT. We'll send a one-page prework checklist (examples: sample token flows, typical request QPS, and any current network egress rules) and a proposed agenda. If Apr 6/7 don't work for you, we'll keep Mar 31 as a shorter 45-minute technical overview but we think the workshop will give much more value.

Proposed agenda (short):
- 10m introductions & goals
- 25m current infra & integration constraints (Quantapulse)
- 35m deep dive: routing, KV/caching, latency tradeoffs
- 15m quantization/hosting options and next steps
- 5m action items

I'll attach the agenda and the prework checklist in a follow-up. Do Apr 6 (2–3:30pm PT) or Apr 7 (1–2:30pm PT) look possible?

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Thanks — Apr 6 (2–3:30pm PT) works for us. Arun noted he has travel the morning of Apr 7 so 6th is preferable. We'll aim to share a short network diagram and our current auth approach by Friday so you can tailor the deep dive.

A couple of asks for the agenda:
- Can you include a short section on rollout patterns for model variants and graceful degradation? That's a key concern for us.
- Can you share any sample latency numbers for similar deployments on A100 vs T4? Even ballpark figures will help our architecture discussion.

If those are possible, we're happy to convert the 31st slot to the workshop on the 6th.

Elena

Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Embedded Architecture Workshop — Apr 6 14:00–15:30 PT

Elena — thanks for the quick confirm. Calendar invite sent (placeholder) and we've attached the agenda & prework checklist. Short notes on your asks:

- Rollout & graceful degradation: Vivek will cover common routing strategies, multi-tier fallbacks (hosted -> dedicated -> cached responses), and how to test fallback behavior during canaries.
- Latency samples: we'll include anonymized A100 vs T4 median p50/p95 numbers for workloads similar to what you described (30–60 token generations, short-chat style). Exact numbers depend on sequence length and batching but we'll share ballpark metrics in the workshop deck.

Attachments: proposed_workshop_agenda.docx, quantapulse_prework_questions.pdf

Action items:
1) Quantapulse: send network diagram + auth flow by Fri EOD (Mar 26).
2) Redwood: send calendar invite + workshop deck draft by Mon Mar 29.

If anything changes on your side, ping me and we'll adjust — otherwise we'll plan for Apr 6 2pm PT.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
